title: The Dataset Inside You: Why Your Gut Microbiome Is Personalised Health's Most Underrated Resource
ai_summary: The gut microbiome contains a vast biological dataset, but metagenomic sequencing alone is insufficient for clinical use. Everlab's test adds a doctor's interpretation layer to the raw data. As sequencing costs fall, this analytical approach is expected to become mainstream in healthcare.

title: The Gut Microbiome Is the Most Overlooked Biomarker in Preventive Health, Here’s Why That Needs to Change
ai_summary: Gut microbiome testing is overlooked in preventive health despite its role in digestion, immunity, and metabolism. The article cites Everlab's doctor-reviewed approach as a key differentiator, arguing it follows the path of cholesterol and blood sugar testing. It suggests gut microbiome testing will become standard in preventive assessments.
